provenance.bundle: resources/app/out/vs/workbench/workbench.desktop.main.js of the pinned 1.129.0 Linux build (sha256 2da8b161d4f865a4f2b21c98cda80f4fce6c4ee8aa13428a6ee5314f14d41802) and its resources/app/extensions/*/package.json

method: Linux rows are the P1 dump rows on every key in keyRoles.linux, verbatim (command and when); VMDE rows and removal rows are excluded.

Windows and macOS keys come from a scan of every keybinding registration in the pinned bundle, resolved with VS Code's platform rule (win/mac/linux override, else primary and secondary), plus built-in extension manifests (win, then linux, then key; mac, then key).

Each scanned registration was matched to its dump row by command and Linux key; the Linux projection of the result equals the dump on every listed key (0 differences). Registrations with no Linux key carry a when decoded by hand.

Hand-decoded: quickInput.accept (computed modifier keys), chatEditor.action.acceptHunk, the four search toggles (shared keybinding constants), replaceAll Cmd+Enter in the Replace input, actions.findWithSelection, terminal.selectAll.
Limit: Windows/macOS registrations whose key is computed at runtime (loops, platform ternaries) are not decoded; none of them resolves to a Linux key in keyRoles.
github.copilot rows come from the built-in extension manifest; that extension was not active in the P1 dump profile.
canHoldRule: canHoldInVmdeWebview is true when some ||-branch of the when clause can be true while keyboard focus is in the active VMDE webview editor with G1 true: activeEditor == 'WebviewEditor', activeCustomEditorId == 'vmde.editor', editorIsOpen and webviewFindWidgetEnabled (VMDE enables the webview find widget) are true; a branch is false if it needs focus in another widget, another active editor, a view or a code-editor/widget-scoped context key. Unknown global context keys are assumed satisfiable.

sanctionedCollisions.basis: Owner convention: Bold keeps Ctrl/Cmd+B (Owner decisions 2026-09-27; Task 505 kept it regardless of collision).
Owner convention: Italic keeps Ctrl/Cmd+I. VS Code binds hold-to-talk voice chat there when a speech provider is installed; recorded for Owner confirmation.
